# Slurrp

> Slurrp is India's largest food & recipe platform with 10,000+ veg/non-veg recipes, community features, and personalized nutrition tools.

Slurrp combines recipe discovery, food articles, and community engagement with innovative tools like Nutrimeter (AI diet planning) and Slurrp 360 (food encyclopedia). The platform features video tutorials, contests, rewards, and regional food trails across Indian cities.

## Key Topics

- Indian cuisine
- Vegetarian & non-vegetarian recipes
- Regional cuisines
- Meal planning
- Food culture
- Community engagement
- Recipe sharing
- Trending recipes
- Breakfast recipes
- Web stories
- Food articles
- Nutrimeter (AI diet planner)
- Slurrp 360 (food encyclopedia)
- Cocktail Sifter
- User-generated content

## Recipe Discovery & Collections

- [Food & Recipes: Easy to make Veg & Non-Veg Recipes](https://www.slurrp.com): Slurrp homepage: 10,000+ veg/non-veg recipes with nutrition info
- [Discover Recipes](https://www.slurrp.com/discover): Recipe discovery: browse curated collections & recipe categories
- [Slurrp 360: The virtual encyclopedia of food](https://www.slurrp.com/slurrp360): Slurrp 360: food encyclopedia with recipes, videos & articles per item
- [Drinks](https://www.slurrp.com/drinks): Drink recipes: cocktails, punches & spirits with curated collections
- [Drinks - Cocktail Sifter](https://www.slurrp.com/drinks/cocktailsifter): Cocktail Sifter: alcoholic & non-alcoholic drink recipes by liquor type
- [Recipe Search](https://www.slurrp.com/new_search): Recipe search results page for user queries across Slurrp platform

## Community & User Engagement

- [Slurrp Community](https://www.slurrp.com/community): Slurrp community: social platform for sharing recipes & cooking
- [Create Community Posts](https://www.slurrp.com/create-thoughts): Community page for creating posts & sharing food thoughts
- [Create Bite Club Groups](https://www.slurrp.com/create-biteclub): Bite Club creation: community groups for food enthusiasts sharing
- [Community Drafts](https://www.slurrp.com/view-draft): Community draft view: manage saved recipes & user-generated content
- [Contests](https://www.slurrp.com/contests): Cooking contests with prize opportunities and community engagement
- [Slurrp Rewards](https://www.slurrp.com/rewards): Slurrp Rewards program: earn points for activity, redeem for prizes

## Video & Visual Content

- [Recipe Videos](https://www.slurrp.com/videos): Recipe videos: cooking tutorials for veg, non-veg & regional dishes
- [Web Stories](https://www.slurrp.com/web-stories): Visual food stories on Indian recipes, regional cuisines & festivals
- [Food Photo Stories](https://www.slurrp.com/photo-stories): Food photo galleries: celebrity food updates & recipe photo stories

## Food Articles & Food Culture

- [Food & Recipes Articles](https://www.slurrp.com/article): Food articles on recipes, cuisines, chef interviews, health & nutrition
- [Food Trails](https://www.slurrp.com/food-trails): Food trails: city guides exploring regional dishes in Indore, Patna
- [Newsletters](https://www.slurrp.com/newsletters): Recipe & food culture newsletters with curated food stories & history

## Personalization & Wellness Tools

- [Nutrimeter](https://www.slurrp.com/nutrimeter): Nutrimeter: AI diet planner calculating BMI & personalized meal plans

## Shopping & Marketplace

- [Slurrp Shop](https://www.slurrp.com/shop): E-commerce: kitchen appliances, cookware & gourmet grocery deals
